sources.title: The psychology of curiosity: A review and reinterpretation
sources.author: George Loewenstein
sources.summary: Curiosity can arise from an identifiable gap in knowledge.
sources.limitations: A psychological theory, not a measured short-video retention effect.

sources.title: States of curiosity modulate hippocampus-dependent learning via the dopaminergic circuit
sources.author: Gruber, Gelman and Ranganath
sources.summary: High curiosity was associated with better memory for trivia answers and incidental material.
sources.limitations: Memory in laboratory tasks is not feed retention or conversion; no dopamine editing recipe follows.

sources.title: Toward a general psychological model of tension and suspense
sources.author: Lehne and Koelsch
sources.summary: Tension involves anticipation of significant outcomes under conflict or uncertainty.
sources.limitations: The model is theoretical and domain-general; it gives no optimal cut frequency or reveal time.

sources.title: Spoiler alert: How narrative film captures attention
sources.author: Cohen and colleagues
sources.summary: In a film task, knowing the ending did not restore the viewers secondary goal performance.
sources.limitations: A narrative-attention task, not a test of short-feed retention; revealing an outcome need not destroy all interest.

sources.title: Creative Codes: 6 principles for creating on TikTok
sources.author: TikTok for Business
sources.summary: TikTok recommends hook, body and close, early value, vertical production and useful audiovisual cues.
sources.limitations: Advertising guidance. The cited six-second figure concerns ad recall impact, not the proportion of viewers retained.

sources.title: Measure key moments for audience retention
sources.author: YouTube Help
sources.summary: Interpret retention dips and spikes with context; a spike can reflect confusion and repeated viewing.
sources.limitations: Highlighted key-moment features have eligibility limits; the 30-second intro measure is not a universal Shorts rule.

sources.title: Content tab analytics tips - Shorts
sources.author: YouTube Help
sources.summary: Shorts analytics separates choosing to view from swiping away and advises comparisons within format.
sources.limitations: Platform-defined denominators and traffic mix matter. Raw views alone do not measure hook quality.

sources.title: On YouTubes recommendation system
sources.author: Cristos Goodrow, YouTube
sources.summary: YouTube describes multiple signals including watch time, surveys and sharing.
sources.limitations: A dated system explanation, not a current ranking formula or a guarantee of distribution.

sources.title: Local clipping comparison on one retained source
sources.author: ClipFactory local benchmark
sources.summary: Complete endings improved while title alignment, dependent openings and small proof screens remained problems.
sources.limitations: One source used for development, no audience experiment and no measured retention uplift.
